lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour. Diff fcab537..01d3461 read: 09a_econ.js changes only the two strap colours (#3a6f9a -> #4a75a5 tongue strap, #353e5e -> #3c4668 navy strap and its over-lip end); geometry is identical to w45.
calibrationNote: Geometry is bit-for-bit the w45 candidate: the q17 cover band count is 981/726/1119/923/702/507/116/33 = 5107 px, exactly the w45b value, which confirms the renders are comparable and that only colour moved. The strap colour change fixes my w45 colour issue in the scene (teal hue and value now inside the photo's range, navy luma inside the 50-65 target). That is worth +0.05 on Belts, but the strap layout (w45b-1, medium) and the q17 cover (w44b-1, medium) are unchanged, so the overall score stays 8.5 on the same scale as w44/w45 (detail mean 8.44, same as w45 plus 0.003).

priorIssues.note: Belt layout unchanged (geometry identical): q17 still shows flat diagonal V straps meeting at a mid-pan latch (right block: teal band runs (780,345) -> (890,397), latch ~(785,345)); y_47303 hangs the teal tongue strap vertically from the armrest/cushion gap (photo strap at x 795-815, y 347-395: bbox h/w ~2.4) with the latch at the pan rear. Render teal bbox in the same block is ~110 x 50 px (h/w 0.45, check >= 1.5). The over-lip navy end in e11 (225-295, 265-335) is still a boxy rectangular flap with a hard horizontal seam. This is geometry, not camera: a more frontal camera would not move the latch to the armrest.

q17 tongue strap median (66,121,175) G/R 1.83 B/G 1.45 L* 49 (w45 (47,111,162) G/R 2.35) vs y_47303 tongue straps (60,118,182) G/R 1.97 / (69,128,196) G/R 1.86, B/G 1.54, L* 49-53: hue and value now in the photo range, about 10-20 low on B only. Same on the other q17 straps ((65,120,174), (64,118,173)). Navy strap smooth px (49,61,107) luma 62.7 (w45 ~45; target 50-65 met), B/R 2.18 vs photo (46,61,96) 2.09. Studio e11 / e7 tongue strap (140,198,227) B/G 1.15 (check >= 1.3 not met): under the white studio key it still reads sky-blue, but that is the studio tonemap on a #4a75a5 base (B/G 1.41), and it is not seen in the cabin. Navy studio (84,102,162) reads right.

q17 near cover 5107 px (identical to w45; check >= 8600). Camera vs geometry: in y_47303 the near seat's grey flap is ~120 x 95 px and faces the camera; in q17 the same seat is seen ~20 deg more edge-on and lower, so the aisle-side wing face fills where the flap would be. I attribute ~70 % of the shortfall to the camera (the cover/wing geometry reads right in e3 / e4 side views and the head-on q15 widths match: inner pair 74/76 vs 71/83) and ~30 % to geometry (the plate foot still sits behind the wing front edge at any yaw > ~15 deg). Re-measure after the camera fix before spending geometry on it.

Same measurements as w45b-2: teal G/R 1.83 (target >= 1.7), within +-20/channel of the photo tongue straps; navy luma 62.7 (target 50-65). The q15 side-block belt check (B/R <= 2.4) now slightly over at 2.63 / 2.68 (see w46b-1).
Side-block pillows still off; q15 left side seat bare where y_47300 has one.
Folded into w45b-1; no change this round.
Centre-block stubs under the q15 pillows, flat piped pillow plaque (e4c), fleck contrast and the dark tray edge under the pan front (e11) all unchanged.
